    Harry Diamond has been Rory McIlroy’s caddie since 2017 and is a key figure in his success, including the 2026 Masters win. A close friend and former fellow golfer from Holywood Golf Club, Northern Ireland, Diamond provides a calm, trusting, and supportive presence on the bag, often acting as a stabilizing influence. 
    In this video, Rory McIlroy shares his insights on what makes his relationship with Harry Diamond work:
    01:43
    How Leaders Lead with David Novak
    YouTube• Apr 23, 2025
    Key Details About Harry Diamond: 
    • Relationship: They have known each other since childhood, with McIlroy describing Diamond as a "big brother" figure.
    • Partnership: Originally a temporary replacement for JP Fitzgerald in 2017, the partnership became permanent due to their strong personal bond and comfort level.
    • Successes: Together, they have won numerous tournaments, including multiple FedEx Cups, Irish Opens, and the 2026 Masters.
    • Presence: Known for a calm demeanor, Diamond is often credited with keeping McIlroy focused during high-stakes moments. 
    Diamond frequently works alongside Rory’s team to manage high-pressure situations, providing a level of comfort that McIlroy values immensely.
